name: Shikabane Maid-chan to Kichiku na Goshujin-sama
original_name: 屍メイドちゃんと鬼畜なご主人様
source:
The daily struggles of a zombie maid girl, created through her master’s experiments.
Whether she’s being teased by Jammer-kun, violated by the tentacles of a pet monster, or double-penetrated by the lizard merchants’ massive ○○○, she bravely lives (and dies) through it all.
Meanwhile, a princess from a certain country who’s infiltrated the mansion falls victim to tentacles, △△△, and ×××.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ062004.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
通过主人的实验创造出僵尸女仆的日常斗争。
无论是被贾莫君戏弄，还是被宠物魔物的触手侵犯，还是被蜥蜴商人的巨大○○○双重插入，她都勇敢地活下去（死了）。
另一方面，潜入宅邸的某国公主，成为了触手、△△△、×××的牺牲品。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ062004.html/]dlsite[/url]]
